name: Apache Pulsar Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free Apache-2.0 self-hosted distributed publish-subscribe messaging and streaming platform with durable topics, subscriptions, queue semantics, multi-tenancy and geo-replication; no vendor-imposed software message quota.
watch_out: Requires self-managed brokers, persistent storage/BookKeeper, metadata services, network security, monitoring and operational expertise. Cloud infrastructure, managed Pulsar and optional connectors can incur charges.
